purpose: CMOS Inverter Chain: 256 stages — stress test

oracle.derivation: A 256-stage level-1 CMOS inverter chain. Dropped 34 of 261 sample rows on switching edges, where the two converged references disagree by more than 0.5x the tolerance. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 8.72e+05x its tolerance off it on the rows kept.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 1e-12
